meta.rule: Skill multipliers unchanged; only names/icons are reskinned. Addon should call GetSpellInfo(wowSpellId) for the localized name/icon and fall back to nameKo/icon.
meta.confidence: Applies to wowSpellId: high = well-known vanilla ID; medium = recalled talent/spell rank-1 ID, likely right; low = uncertain ID (name/icon kept).
meta.masterySource: talent = real vanilla talent (rank-1 ID; rank N shown in name); talentExtraRank = rank number beyond the talent's real max ranks; generated = "<mapped spell> 숙련 N" using the parent/basic-attack row's spell.
meta.linkedSkills: Non-row sub-skills (e.g. 14051) inherit the owner row's mapping: linkedSkills[subId] = ownerRowId.
meta.classIconNote: ClassIcon_* are Interface\Icons textures; specIcon = classic talent-tab icon of that tree.
